citationText: 1. Rather than cite primary references, the plan adopted here is that of referring to secondary works, which themselves cite primary references, but which are more readily available to the interested reader who wishes to pursue certain questions in more detail. Primary sources are cited when they are currently available or are not thoroughly treated in secondary works.
